title: Ship ignores the Check of a cancelled run superseded on the same SHA
body:
Source: ufltpv takeover agent, 2026-11-20 (shipping #1529).
Evidence: `krn pr ship` exited 74 because it read the Check of a cancelled run, although a newer run on the same SHA had concluded success.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts (Check lookup), test/ci/ship*.test.ts
Outcome: for a given SHA, ship reads the conclusion of the newest non-cancelled run; a cancelled run superseded by a newer one never yields exit 74.
Proof: a test with a captured `gh run list` sequence (one cancelled run, then one successful run on the same SHA) shows ship exiting 0 with verdict merged.

Root cause (takeover agent, 2026-11-20): the 'edited' pull_request trigger added in #1530 (c70c6b0) starts a second CI run whenever ship edits the PR title or body; that run cancels the first, and ship reads the cancelled Check as red. It hit #1537 and #1534. Fix both ends: ship waits for the newest run on the head, and the edited trigger runs only the PR-body job, or does not cancel the test run.
